The vertical axis is labeled 'Value' and has tick marks from 0 to 55, with major gridlines at intervals of 5.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Category' and has labeled tick marks for 'Quality', 'Price', 'Design', 'Support', 'Delivery', and 'Other'.
A blue circular mark is positioned above the 'Quality' label on the x-axis, with the text '36%' directly above it. Its y-value is approximately 35.

A blue circular mark is positioned above the 'Design' label on the x-axis, with the text '34%' directly above it. Its y-value is approximately 54.
A blue circular mark is positioned above the 'Support' label on the x-axis, with the text '45%' directly above it. Its y-value is approximately 30.

public_definitions: The goal is to assign additional promotional budget to the category with the highest current labeled rating share.
The dashboard labeled rating-share values are the evidence source for the decision.
The 'Select Other', 'Select Design', and 'Select Support' options are the only categories presented in the form for selection.
The 'Assign additional promotional budget' action is required for submission.
The 'Prioritize highest current rating share' rule is required for submission.
The 'Rating-share category promotion' campaign program is required for submission.
uncertain: The 'Other' category is not shown in the chart, but is listed as an option in the form. Its rating share is not visible in the chart, so its value cannot be compared to the others.

The 'Design' category has a labeled rating share of 34%, which is the lowest among the visible categories, but its position on the chart is not consistent with its value (it is the highest point on the chart).
